title: Mijas Costa contemporary off-plan town homes for sale
summary:
Contemporary off-plan development in Mijas Costa consisting of 3 and 4 bedroom semi-detached houses. These Mijas Costa town homes, designed with a focus on comfort and wellbeing, are located on a hillside overlooking the Mediterranean in a quiet area, tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the coastal towns, but within easy reach of all facilities.

These Mijas Costa town homes offer spacious, bright accommodation over two floors and each have a private garden with the option of adding a private pool. In addition to the 3 or 4 bedrooms, the town houses have two bathrooms (1 en suite), a guest toilet, a spacious and versatile open concept living room and kitchen area with access to the private terrace, which is perfect for outdoor living.

The communal facilities with these Mijas Costa town homes include a saline chlorination pool, gymnasium, social room and landscaped garden areas. These homes are ideally located close to the coast’s beautiful beaches, transport networks, international schools, an excellent range of restaurants and cafés, sports facilities and numerous golf courses, making the area extremely popular with golf enthusiasts. The delightful coastal towns of La Cala de Mijas and the busier towns of Fuengirola and Marbella are just a short drive away.

These light and inviting Mijas Costa town homes are perfectly situated for those looking for a tranquil setting while appreciating the benefits of having access to good amenities. Malaga International Airport can be reached within 30 minutes and there are good bus links nearby to the entire stretch of coastline.

The high quality construction, design and superb range of amenities of this development make these Mijas Costa town homes excellent value for money.
